Ferdinand marched with his army against the French and entered Rome (29 November). On the defeat of some of his columns, Ferdinand hurried back to Naples. On the approach of the French, Ferdinand fled on 23 December 1798 aboard Nelson's ship [HMS *Vanguard*](/wiki/HMS_Vanguard_(1787) "HMS Vanguard (1787)") to [Palermo](/wiki/Palermo "Palermo"), leaving his capital in a state of anarchy.[[3]](#cite_note-Davis-3)[[2]](#cite_note-EB1911-2) The weather was extremely stormy and the king's 6-year-old younger son [Prince Alberto](/wiki/Prince_Alberto_of_Naples_and_Sicily "Prince Alberto of Naples and Sicily") died of exhaustion during the voyage, in the arms of [Emma, Lady Hamilton](/wiki/Emma,_Lady_Hamilton "Emma, Lady Hamilton"), Nelson's mistress.[[4]](#cite_note-4)
